verdict.summary: Fabrinet is the invisible backbone of the AI infrastructure boom. The company manufactures precision optical transceivers, modules, and laser systems used in data centers, telecom networks, and autonomous vehicles. With 35.9% revenue growth, 4 consecutive EPS beats, and a partnership with Aurora Innovation for self-driving truck hardware, FN sits at the intersection of every major tech megatrend. The stock has rallied +185% in one year but recently pulled back 15% from its $633 high — creating a potential re-entry window near the EMA50 ($502).
whyBuy: 35.9% revenue growth — accelerating demand from hyperscale data centers and AI infrastructure
4/4 EPS beats — consistent execution with rising margins, analyst target $574 (+17.6%)
$961M cash, near-zero debt — fortress balance sheet with 18.7% ROE
Aurora Innovation deal — selected for gen-2 autonomous truck hardware (1,500 units capacity)
1.6T optical transceivers — next-gen positioning for 2027 upgrade cycle
whyAvoid: Valuation stretched — P/E 53.6x vs sector 27.2x, DCF suggests 70% premium
Customer concentration — heavy reliance on top 5 optical OEM customers
Low gross margins — 12% gross margin is thin for a "tech" company
Geopolitical risk — manufacturing concentrated in Thailand, supply chain exposure to Asia
